themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Push or breaking-news alerts, including the lack of an option to turn them off or customize them, and notifications that don't clear after being tapped.

themes.name: Playlist persistence
themes.description: Saved playlists or queues being deleted, cleared when the app closes, or not remembered between sessions.

themes.name: Playlist playback and management
themes.description: How the playlist plays and is managed: stories starting mid-way or skipping to the next, reordering and deleting items, finding the playlist, and building it from top stories.

themes.name: Live stream connectivity
themes.description: Whether live radio and local station streams connect and play, including 'unable to play this media' errors, endless connecting or loading, and station search and finding nearby stations.

themes.name: Buffering and dropouts
themes.description: Audio that buffers, stalls, cuts out, or stops unexpectedly during streaming or podcast playback, including drops on network changes or signal loss and cutoffs at around 20 minutes.

themes.name: Audio skipping and position
themes.description: Audio that jumps backward or forward, repeats, or cuts off the end of stories, and failure to remember the listening position or resume where it left off.

themes.name: App crashes and freezes
themes.description: The app crashing, force closing, freezing, hanging, failing to open, or stopping working after an Android or app update.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: The app running or starting by itself in the background, restarting, or using excessive battery, memory, or data while not in use.

themes.name: Lock screen and wallpaper bug
themes.description: A Samsung Note 3 or KitKat issue where the app flashes against the lock screen, making it hard to unlock the phone, and deletes the wallpaper.

themes.name: Chromecast and Android Auto
themes.description: Requests for or comments on Chromecast, casting, or Android Auto support.

themes.name: Offline downloads
themes.description: Requests or complaints about being unable to download episodes, stories, or playlists for offline listening or caching.

themes.name: Tablet and screen rotation
themes.description: Landscape mode, auto-rotation, and tablet-optimized layouts, including tablet-only crashes or display problems.

themes.name: Interface design and navigation
themes.description: Visual design, look and feel, Material Design, ease of navigation, number of taps, layout, and dated or iOS-like appearance.

themes.name: Widget
themes.description: The home screen widget, including its functionality, resizing, and what controls it offers.

themes.name: Text size and article display
themes.description: Font size and readability, garbled or overlapping article text, and missing images, maps, videos, or photos within articles.

themes.name: Political bias
themes.description: Perceptions of NPR's political slant or fairness, whether liberal, anti-Trump, or balanced and unbiased.

themes.name: Privacy and permissions
themes.description: Concerns about the app accessing phone calls, call history, contacts, or other personal information.

themes.name: Ads and sponsorship
themes.description: Banner ads, pop-up ads, and sponsorship or underwriting messages in the app or audio.

themes.name: Program and podcast availability
themes.description: Availability of specific shows, episodes, or podcasts, such as missing episodes, programs tab not working, the 'load more' list repeating, and requests to add shows.

themes.name: Content freshness and coverage
themes.description: How current the stories and hourly news are, including stale or old stories, hourly news not updating, and lack of coverage on weekends.
